outcome: clinical findings (immobility in limbs, pressure injury, use of invasive devices, feelings of fear)
cohort: An 18-year-old pregnant woman who suffered a spinal cord injury.
finding: Clinical findings like immobility, pressure injury, invasive device use, fear, and emergency cesarean section were observed, leading to specific nursing diagnoses that informed the care plan.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean section was observed as a clinical finding in the patient.
